mapper.insert: insert into api_automation_spec ( id, project_id, source_type, source_ref, name, version_label, spec_digest, content_size_bytes, sanitized_spec_json, parse_summary_json, status, parser_version, endpoint_count, parse_error_summary, created_by, updated_by, parsed_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRef}, #{name}, #{versionLabel}, #{specDigest}, #{contentSizeBytes}, cast(coalesce(#{sanitizedSpecJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{parseSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{status}, #{parserVersion}, #{endpointCount}, #{parseErrorSummary}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{parsedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update api_automation_spec set sanitized_spec_json = cast(coalesce(#{sanitizedSpecJson}, '{}') as jsonb), parse_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{parseSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), status = #{status}, parser_version = #{parserVersion}, endpoint_count = #{endpointCount}, parse_error_summary = #{parseErrorSummary}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, parsed_at = #{parsedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select from api_automation_spec
order by created_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}

order by created_at desc limit #{query.limit} offset #{query.offset}
mapper.update: update api_automation_endpoint_snapshot set asset_api_id = #{assetApiId}, diff_status = #{diffStatus}, diff_summary_json = cast(coalesce(#{diffSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), last_diff_at = #{lastDiffAt}, synced_at = #{syncedAt}, sync_error_summary = #{syncErrorSummary}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from api_automation_endpoint_snapshot where spec_id = #{specId} order by path asc, http_method asc
mapper.insert: insert into api_automation_generation_task ( id, project_id, spec_id, request_key, request_digest, generation_mode, coverage_types_json, status, prompt_key, prompt_version, model_invocation_id, fallback_used, api_count, case_count, input_summary_json, error_summary, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{specId}, #{requestKey}, #{requestDigest}, #{generationMode}, cast(coalesce(#{coverageTypesJson}, '[]') as jsonb), #{status}, #{promptKey}, #{promptVersion}, #{modelInvocationId}, #{fallbackUsed}, #{apiCount}, #{caseCount}, cast(coalesce(#{inputSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{errorSummary}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

insert into api_automation_case ( id, task_id, project_id, spec_id, endpoint_snapshot_id, asset_api_id, asset_test_case_id, title, http_method, path, coverage_type, expected_status, assertion_summary_json, request_template_json, source, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{specId}, #{endpointSnapshotId}, #{assetApiId}, #{assetTestCaseId}, #{title}, #{httpMethod}, #{path}, #{coverageType}, #{expectedStatus}, cast(coalesce(#{assertionSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{requestTemplateJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{source}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

insert into api_automation_script_bundle ( id, project_id, task_id, status, bundle_digest, file_count, file_tree_summary_json, dependency_summary_json, static_check_status, static_check_summary_json, review_note, submitted_by, approved_by, submitted_at, approved_at, rejected_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{status}, #{bundleDigest}, #{fileCount}, cast(coalesce(#{fileTreeSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), cast(coalesce(#{dependencySummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{staticCheckStatus}, cast(coalesce(#{staticCheckSummaryJson}, '{}') as jsonb), #{reviewNote}, #{submittedBy}, #{approvedBy}, #{submittedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{rejectedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update api_automation_script_bundle set status = #{status}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, rejected_at = #{rejectedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}

update api_automation_run set status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id} and status in ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: select from api_automation_case where task_id = #{taskId} order by path asc, coverage_type asc
select from api_automation_script_bundle where task_id = #{taskId} order by created_at desc
select from api_automation_run_result where run_id = #{runId} order by created_at asc
